author: Animalogic
description:
Long before dinosaurs ruled the Earth, a true apex predator dominated the oceans. Meet Dunkleosteus, the armored mega fish that terrorized the seas during the Devonian period, a time when life was just beginning to explode in the oceans. 

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
